title: OperationsConfig
description: The Threat Director's operation catalog, content/operations.yaml (CONFIG-AND-CONTENT §8a, THREAT-DIRECTOR §4, Q-TD-7, Q-SIM-81; NX-156). Each operation is a job template posted on the Static's Tasking Board, or an effect with no jobs. Priority is not here: it is `director.op_priority.<id>` in the balance profile. The loader also checks the cross-file rules: a priority for every operation and none for another, unit kinds that are ENEMY movers, a unit kind that fits its job kind, a selector that suits its job kind, a precondition that suits the target, a cost within the largest tier budget, and no operation needing more units than `director.max_spawns_per_window`.

schema_version.description: File format version, unitless; the loader accepts only 1 (§4.4).

id.description: UPPER_SNAKE, unique. Also the <op> of director.op_priority.<op> and what STAFF_DIRECTOR_OVERRIDE.trigger_operation names.

target.description: What a candidate aims at: NODE (a node id), SECTOR (a sector id), RADAR (a Static radar, named by its base node), CONVOYS (the Static's unescorted convoys, one candidate) or GARRISON (a Static base with fewer live Director units homed there than its garrison_quota, Q-SIM-85; the kind bought comes from `director.garrison.kinds`, so its jobs omit `unit_kinds`).

preconditions.description: Closed list; each must hold for a candidate. Which targets suit which is checked by the loader. No duplicates (loader).

cost.description: Budget points, whole, the operation's only price (Q-TD-8, Q-TD-12); its units cost nothing extra.

effect.description: What an operation without jobs does: EMISSION_BLINK turns the target radar dark for `director.decoy_blink.dark_s` (DecoyBlink, FOW-11, Q-SIM-82). Exactly one of `effect` and `jobs`.

jobs.description: Posted in order; each later job depends on the one before (TB-8). One unit is bought per slot.

memory.description: The threat-memory counter that moves this operation's score (THREAT-DIRECTOR §2, §4 step 4): RAISE multiplies by 1 + the counter (the counter counts events, decayed), LOWER divides by it. A by-sector counter reads the target's sector (a NODE or SECTOR target). Omitted: no counter matches, multiplier 1.

track_age.description: SECTOR targets only: the score is also multiplied by 1 + how stale the Static's picture of the sector is, 0 with a current track there, up to 1 for a last-known track about to fade or none at all (TD-5).

at.description: Where, resolved against the Static's view (TD-2): target, target_defenses (the target node's defenses), nearest_own_base (the Static base nearest the target), sector_point (a point of the sector: its stalest area outside every known coalition air-defense ring that is not Disabled, reached by a route that crosses none; none: the operation is dropped) or each_convoy (one job per unescorted Static convoy).

unit_kinds.description: ENEMY kinds bought for the job's slots, in turn. Required, except for a GARRISON operation, whose kind is `director.garrison.kinds` (loader).
